 ORDER

This first application has been filed by applicant under Section 439 of Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973 for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.267 of 2023 registered at Police Station Matabasaiya, District Morena (M.P.) for offence punishable under Sections 363, 376, 506 of IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act.
Applicant is in judicial custody since 23.12.2023.

As per the case of prosecution, elder brother of victim reported to Police Station Matabasaiya,
District Morena that his younger sister aged around 17 years is missing since the morning on 15.12.2023.
He suspects that his neighbour Sonu S/o Narayan Singh Jatav has enticed and taken his minor sister.
On such allegation, Police Station Matabasaiya registered FIR at Crime 267 of 2023 for offence punishable under Section 363 of IPC against unknown person.
Victim was recovered on 17.12.2023, on her appearance before Police Station Matabasaiya along with Sonu Jatav.
The statements of victim were recorded under Sections 161 and 164 of CrPC on 17.12.2023 wherein she stated that she went to meet her friend Muskan at Indore.

Sonu informed her that her parents had Sonu vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/93033479/
1 lodged report at police station, therefore, she returned to Morena with Sonu.

sentences.text: Sonu has not done any misdeed with her.
Later, on 22.12.2023, victim appeared before PS Kotwali Morena along with her mother.
In her supplementary statement, she alleged that Sonu had taken her to Indore.

Thereafter,
she was taken to Guna.
They stayed in separate rooms at Guna.
When they were returning to Morena, Sonu committed rape on her in the night of 16.12.2023.
On such allegations, PS Matabasaiya added prosecution for offence punishable U/s 376 and 506 of IPC and 3/4 of POCSO Act.
Sunu Jatav was arrested on 23.12.2023.
He is in custody ever since.
On completion of investigation, final report was submitted.
The trial is underway.
Leaned Counsel for the applicant, in addition to the grounds mentioned in the application, submits that applicant has been falsely implicated in this matter merely on the basis of suspicion.
The victim initially made no allegtion agaisnt the applicant.

Later, under the pressure of her family members,
she alleged rape against the applicant.

Learned counsel referring to DNA report dated 20.3.2024 given by Scientific Officer of State Regional Forensic Science Laboratory, Gwalior submitted that no ''Y-Chromosome STR DNA Profile'' was detected from source material of the victim to connect the applicant with alleged offence.

entities.text: State Regional Forensic Science Laboratory, Gwalior
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Learned counsel further submits that applicant is aged around 24 years.
He is pursuing study of Bachelor degree, therefore, there is no likelihood o f his absconsion leaving his home and study.
No criminal antecedent is reported against the applicant.
No custodial interrogation is needed.
There is no likelihood of tampering with evidence by the applicant as both the parties relate to same socio-economic status.
Trial would take time to conclude.

Therefore,
applicant may be extended the benefit of bail.
Per contra, learned Counsel for the State opposes the bail application on the ground of gravity of alleged offence.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
Considering the arguments advanced by both the parties and overall circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merits of the case, this Court is inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Thus, the application is allowed.
